connections.reason: C_DRV_1D StartAut input normally receives the CmdOn output from the associated C_GROUP.
C_DRV_1D StopAut input normally receives the PeCmdOff output from the associated C_GROUP.
C_DRV_1D QuickStp input should be connected to the QuicStpQ output of the associated C_GROUP for immediate stopping.
C_GROUP FbObjOn input should receive the final running feedback of the plant section, which can be the RunSig output of the last C_DRV_1D.
C_GROUP FbObjOff input should receive the final stopped feedback, which can be the negated RunSig output of the first C_DRV_1D.
The main group's G_LINK output should connect directly to the GR_LINK1 input of the associated C_DRV_1D.
C_GROUP MatFlt input should receive an OR of all conveying drives' DynFlt outputs unless material-fault transfer is done automatically via GR_LINK.
C_DRV_1D Ack input may be connected to the AckGr output of the associated C_GROUP for group-wise acknowledgement.
